department: School of Science — Department of Physics

deadline.value: Fall 2027-28 non-local full-time deadline is June 1, 2027 (rolling admissions; local full-time deadline July 15, 2027; HKPFS Step 1/2 deadline December 1, 2026).
deadline.quote: For 2027/28 Fall Term Intake (commencing in Sep 2027): | Non-local Applicants* | Full-time: 1 Jun 2027 | Local Applicants | Full-time: 15 Jul 2027 | Admissions is on rolling basis.

also.quote: 1 Dec 2026 (12noon, GMT+8) | Step 2 deadline at HKUST: | 1 Dec 2026 (11:59pm, GMT+8)

gre_subject.value: Not required centrally (FYTGS notes GRE/GMAT is normally required only by Business and Management programs); Physics notes selection considers academic records and available results of standardized tests in physics.
gre_subject.quote: Required only if there is a Program-Specific Requirement on public examination achievements, e.g. GMAT, GRE | GMAT and GRE are normally required by Programs in the School of Business and Management only

also.quote: Selection for admission will be based on academic records and available results of standardized tests in physics, proficiency in the English language, letters of reference and a personal interview at the discretion of the Department.

supervisor.value: Department PG admissions and 2027-28 catalog pages do not state a pre-application supervisor contact requirement.

funding.value: Qualified full-time MPhil/PhD students receive Postgraduate Studentships (HK$229,620/yr, ~US$29,420/yr in 2026/27) with TA duties, plus School of Science RedBird PhD Award (HK$40,000 + 1st-year tuition waiver for new international PhD students) and HKPFS (HK$28,700/mo).
funding.quote: Postgraduate studentship (PGS) is awarded to qualified full-time PhD or MPhil student of the University to provide them with financial assistance during the course of their study. The amount of PGS is HK$229,620 (~US$29,420) per year (rate is for 2026/27 academic year).

entry_route.value: Admits bachelor's holders with outstanding performance (4-year full-time PhD) and research master's holders (3-year full-time PhD).
entry_route.quote: Full-time: 3 years (with a relevant research master’s degree), 4 years (without a relevant research master’s degree) | Applicants seeking admissions to a doctoral degree program should have obtained a bachelor’s degree with a proven record of outstanding performance from a recognized institution; or presented evidence of satisfactory work at the postgraduate level on a full-time basis for at least one year

notes: Includes optional Scientific Computation Concentration and active Particle Physics & Cosmology research group (no standalone Astronomy & Astrophysics PhD department at HKUST).
